title: ACE 2
build: Cascade Games UK disk, labelled v1.1L by the C64 Preservation Project

tools.host: Linux x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04, no display (cloud container)

exclude: zero page, stack and the game's variables in pages 2 to 8: runtime state, cleared at each start ($30D9) and never loaded
the two screens the game draws into and shows in turn; at the hand-over they hold the end of the loading picture
under the I/O chips, never read: every byte is $FD, a zero byte on the disk after the loader's EOR $FD
never loaded or used: the RAM's power-on pattern
include: the CASCADE logo's eight sprite shapes, kept under the I/O chips and copied out at each start of the title ($0A95)
the title's character set, kept under the I/O chips while a game runs and swapped with $8800-$8FFF ($53D4)
